scopes.meetings:write: Create and change meetings and recordings
Create and change meetings and recordings

n.description: Segments held; a failed batch is resent from here

stop.description: Someone asked, from the portal, to stop recording

from.description: Index of the first segment in this batch

reader.description: What went wrong reading the call app (a reader profile that stopped matching), since the last batch taken

speakers.description: Names for the live voices so far (who the call app showed speaking during each line); sent when they change. Names set by hand are kept

ended.description: The last batch: the recording ended

channel.description: mic = whoever runs the recorder, system = everyone else

t_ms.description: When, from the start of the recording

visible.description: The call app could be read; false: people are the last ones seen, nobody is known to speak

Participants.description: Who is in the call now; sent when it changes

source.description: platform: the call app showed them speaking; llm: inferred from what was said; user: set by hand

confidence.description: How sure the source is, 0–1; none for user

languages.description: Spoken in the call, e.g. ["pt", "en"]; each turn is transcribed in one of them

live.description: Send the transcript while the call goes on (transcript.live); default true

tracks.description: Audio kept after the call; default the recorder's setting

speakers.description: Read who is in the call and who speaks from the call app; default true

RecordingConfig.description: What the creator asked to capture

token.description: Bearer token for this recording only: its live transcript, transcript and audio (scope recordings:upload)

expires_at.description: 6 h after it was made; ask again (same id) for a longer call

allOf.description: Who the call app showed in the call, last time the recorder read it; absent when it couldn't

attendees.description: Everyone the call app listed at some point of the recording, in the order they appeared

ref.description: The creator's own id for it, as given

id.description: Chosen by the caller, so a retry creates nothing new

meeting_id.description: From a context match; omitted → a new meeting

ref.description: The caller's own id for it (an interview, a ticket…), kept as given

metadata.description: Up to 20 key/values kept with the recording

upload.description: Also return an upload token: for a backend that hands the recording to a desktop app (the Desktop SDK), which then sends it with that token only

secret.description: Shown once. Each delivery carries Recordem-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of `${t}.${raw body}` with this secret>; reject a t older than 5 minutes

url.description: https (http only for localhost); receives POSTs of StreamEvent

disabled_at.description: Turned off after its deliveries failed for 3 days

url.description: https (http only for localhost); receives POSTs of StreamEvent

subject.description: The user id, or the client id for a machine token

workspace.description: The workspace the token acts in

client.description: The OAuth client that obtained the token

language.description: What they are written in: the transcript's language

model.description: The language model that wrote them

owner.description: Who took it, as named in the transcript; null when nobody did

points.description: Facts, decisions and open questions, in the order discussed

url.description: Short-lived; works in an <audio> element, no token needed

speakers.description: Names for the voices; a label not listed has none

matched_by.description: link: same call code; time: a meeting of yours now

at.description: When the call started; default now

url.description: The call's link, when the recorder can see it

title.description: The meeting window's title (Meet puts the code there)

meeting_id.description: Another meeting of the workspace; null → a meeting of its own

name.description: null or empty: the voice goes back to unnamed

speakers.description: Names for the voices; names set by hand are kept, and entries with source user here are ignored

revision.description: Bumped on every change; a recorder keeps the higher of its own and this

data.description: transcript.live: {from, segments}; transcript.speakers: {speakers}; participants.updated: Participants; track.ready: Track; others: {}

post.description: A batch past what is held is not stored: the answer tells the recorder where to resend from. After the final transcript, batches are ignored.
Idempotent by `id`. Without `meeting_id`, a meeting is created from the call's link, app and title. With `upload`, also a token for a desktop app to send it (asked again, a fresh one).

post.summary: Send the workspace's events to a URL
post.description: The same events as /v1/stream, POSTed one by one, signed, retried with backoff for 3 days.

201.description: The endpoint, with its signing secret (shown once)

delete.description: With all its recordings, transcripts and audio. Only when every recording in it is yours.

204.description: Deleted, with its transcript and audio

delete.description: Only who recorded it. Its transcript and audio go with it; a meeting left empty is removed too.

204.description: Deleted, with its transcript and audio

200.description: The token's subject, workspace and scopes

get.summary: A recording's notes: summary, action items, topics
get.description: Written by a language model from the final transcript, which also names voices it can tell from what was said (`source: llm`). Not found until they are ready (event `notes.ready`), nor when the server has no language model configured.
Redirects to a short-lived URL, or serves the bytes.

put.description: `mix`: both channels for playback (AAC). `mic_hq`: the recorder's own microphone at 48 kHz (Opus or FLAC).

get.summary: A short-lived URL for a track
get.description: For players that can't send a token (an <audio> element).

put.description: Replaces the live draft and ends the recording.

get.summary: Meetings of the workspace, newest first

next.description: Cursor for the next page; null at the end

post.summary: What a call that just started could be
post.description: The recorder asks this when a meeting app takes the microphone. Meetings with the same call link near that time come first, then the caller's meetings at that time.

post.summary: Move a recording to another meeting, or to one of its own
post.description: For a recording linked to the wrong meeting. The meeting it leaves is removed when nothing else is in it.

200.description: The recording, in its new meeting

patch.summary: Name a voice of the transcript, by hand
patch.description: Sets `source: user`; a final transcript delivered again keeps it. A label no segment has is not found.

put.summary: Send what the call app's window looked like when its reader broke
put.description: Sent only when the person allows it: the last good snapshot of the call's stage and the one that broke (`<t_ms>-good.json.gz`, `<t_ms>-bad.json.gz`), so the reader profile can be fixed. Gzipped JSON, 4 MB at most, 6 per recording.

413.description: Too large, or too many for this recording

get.summary: How to read each call app
get.description: Public, no token: a recorder needs it before any recording exists. Answers 304 to a matching If-None-Match.

post.description: The recorder reads it in its next live batch answer (`stop: true`).

get.description: Each `data:` line is a StreamEvent (`event:` is its type). Filter to one recording with `recording_id`. After a reconnect, read the current state (e.g. the transcript) again, then keep streaming.
